QuestInfo.0: Are you ready to flutter that shutter? It's time to take some pictures of #bMaple World's Famous Places#k!
QuestInfo.1:
Snap 3 pictures of Maple World's most famous people for CONY. It looks like the camera she gave you is an older model, so the flash takes #b5 minutes#k to charge back up after taking a photo.
CONY told you the places she wants you to take pictures of today, so all you need to do is go there and take the pictures.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered 3 pictures of #bfamous places#k to CONY and received a LINE FRIENDS Coin as a gift. It looks like you can exchange them for some keen rewards at the LINE FRIENDS Store.
